tweet.text:
Things are about to get alien.
Look at this proof. The answer isn't the crazy part. It's how it got there. The key step connects two ideas that no human thought were connected. Mathematicians reading it call it alien math. It works, it checks out, and it still feels like it came from somewhere else.
This is the beginning of alien math. Proofs that are correct but don't think like we do.
And it won't stop at math. Alien physics is next. New ideas about how reality works that no human would have come up with. Theories that work but feel like they came from another civilization.
After that, alien chemistry. Alien materials. Alien medicine. Alien engineering.
We're not just getting faster science. We're getting a different kind of science.
This is the least alien it will ever be.
